query.normalizedText:
select
	sum(l_extendedprice) / $1 as avg_yearly
from
	lineitem,
	part
where
	p_partkey = l_partkey
	and p_brand = $2
	and p_container = $3
	and l_quantity < (
		select
			$4 * avg(l_quantity)
		from
			lineitem
		where
			l_partkey = p_partkey
	)
